_what: A7-LOCK (Composition PR 4, ACTIVATION_PRECONDITIONS.md) — the VERSION FREEZE DECLARATION of record for the ARCHETYPE_IDENTITY_VERSION composition event. freezeDeclaration: FROZEN between FINAL-DRYRUN ratification and the activation record write: ARCHETYPE_IDENTITY_VERSION, RULE_LIBRARY_VERSION, the candidate registry manifestHash, and the compositionEnforcement kernel content hash.
